name: openai-realtime-voice
conclusion: openai-realtime-voice (Ask) specifies 1 of 5 categories: 3 validation rules; none for autonomy limits, clarification rules, approval gates, escalation rules. Strongest: validation rules.

validation.conclusion: 3 validation rules (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose: re-checking OpenAI API facts before release; release-blocking review checklist.

statements.quote: Re-check model identifiers, prices, session limits, voices, API object fields, data retention, and policy requirements before production release because Realtime surfaces change quickly.
Block release until these are true:
The model, API fields, price assumptions, session duration, voice list, transport path, and policy constraints have been re-verified against OpenAI docs with a date.
